about: Model profiles (SPEC section 6). Seeded from the Higgsfield CLI docs on the date above. Live limits and costs always come from the provider (higgsfield model get, higgsfield generate cost); anything in 'unconfirmed' is a best guess. 'flags' are the CLI flags the model accepts (media flags written with underscores: start_image is sent as --start-image). 'param_map' renames a generic param to the model's own flag; 'resolution_via' sets other flags for a size; 'media_mode' switches a mode flag when media inputs are present; 'in_model_list' false means the id is known not to appear in 'higgsfield model list' (null: not known).
